source_comments: IBSI-1 PAT1 reference values, configs C / D / E (3D).
Source: IBSI reference data set tables
matching G2. Unnormalized GLRLM GLN/RLN and GLCM Correlation/IMC1 from
3D-merged PAT1 columns are omitted (they scale with the 13 directions).
Config D also omits three GLRLM ratios whose 3D-averaged residuals sit
just outside the published 3D-merged absolute tolerances (SRE, LRHGLE, RLNN).
